More questions jewellers ask.

Which Jwero setup fits my kind of jewellery business?

Jwero is one system for every kind of jewellery business: single stores, chains, franchises, gold, diamond and silver retail, wholesale, traders and manufacturers. Each business type switches on the parts it needs first. Run it yourself for ₹18,000 a month, first month ₹3,600, or let Jwero’s specialists and AI run it for you.

Can one system handle retail, wholesale and manufacturing together?

Yes. Jwero runs the counter, B2B orders, the workshop and the books on one record, so a business that does more than one of these does not need separate software for each.

Do I pay more for a bigger or more complex business?

The subscription is ₹18,000 a month with every module. Extra locations are ₹2,999 each. Groups and chains can take Enterprise, which is custom priced.

Can Jwero run the work for me instead of my team?

Yes. With the managed service, Jwero’s specialists and AI run the functions you hand over, such as marketing, follow-ups and online sales. There is no subscription, and every tool is included.
